reason: The three transformations and their separation are distilled from the pinned cannbot-dsl reference kernels (samples/matmul/matmul/matmul_streamk.py and samples/matmul/quant_matmul/quant_batch_matmul_mxa8w4.py at commit 4519e5372a8b9306f7d823688c0cb8141ee34fb1) and the CANNBot DSL / AISS tiling solver contracts (commit f305e200aa4b1e1fed73cd21ff1f083b8df25a1e). No paired hardware timing campaign, leave-one-out ablation execution or hidden-input retention run was executed in this distillation pass, so this receipt records a source-grounded transformation hypothesis and verification contract without claiming a measured speedup.

factors.change: When total_tiles = ceil(M / bm) * ceil(N / bn) is not divisible by aic_num (rem = total_tiles % aic_num != 0), partition work into sk_tiles = rem + aic_num (when total_tiles > aic_num and rem > 0, else rem) and dp_tiles = total_tiles - sk_tiles, distribute sk_tiles * k_iters_per_tile evenly across all aic_num cores, map tile IDs with a width-4 sliding window + odd-row serpentine reversal for L2 reuse, and run a 4-stage L1 / 2-stage L0 software pipeline.
signals: total_tiles % aic_num != 0 leaves a tail wave with idle AIC cores
row-major tile assignment causes low L2 hit rate on large M/N GEMM
single-buffer L1/L0 staging exposes MTE2 and MTE1 latency between K steps

factors.change: Write unsplit full-K tiles directly from L0C to C_gm via Fixpipe (F322BF16/F322F16) while routing split-K partials to workspace_gm[t * aic_num + sub_idx]; synchronize via AIC->AIV0 FIX-to-MTE2 CrossCoreSetFlag, AIV0 atomic_add on sync_gm[0] with DataCacheCleanAndInvalid('SINGLE_CACHE_LINE') spin-wait, and parallel AIV register accumulation (REDUCE_CHUNK = 16384) before a single output cast.
signals: all tiles are routed through a global workspace even when k_start == 0 and k_end == k_iters_per_tile
unordered atomic fp16/bf16 global additions cause accumulation drift or non-deterministic outputs
polling sync_gm without SINGLE_CACHE_LINE invalidation deadlocks on stale L2/UB cache lines

factors.change: Select (bm, bn, bk) with a makespan-aware Roofline cost model, unpack int4x2 E2M1 weights on dual AIVs via mask/shift/vzip bit permutation into fp8_e4m3fn bytes [s 0 0 e e m 0 0] (exact 1/64 value) compensated by bias * 2^-6 and Fixpipe deq_scale = 64.0, stage unpacked weights through a k_l1-deep L1 ring with DualParam(0, 1) split-M across AIV0/AIV1, and narrow K-tail L1 DMA to 64-aligned and mx_matmul k_actual to 32-aligned without GM padding.
signals: LUT or multi-step scalar/vector int4->fp8 conversion bottlenecks AIV in W4A8/MXA8W4 matmul
explicit vector multiplication by 64.0 after unpacking adds extra VF instructions per K tile
host-side GM K-padding copies the entire activation and weight tensors when K % bk != 0

leave_one_out_arms.purpose: Evaluate the complete DPSK Stream-K scheduling + 3-phase AIV register reduction and MXA8W4 bit-permuted Dual-AIV L1 ring pipeline.
Revert to pure data-parallel tile assignment with row-major ordering to isolate tail-wave load balance and L2 locality gains.
Isolate the direct L0C->GM bypass for full-K tiles and the chunked AIV register reduction while preserving fp32 partial accumulation and cache-line invalidation.
Isolate the 1/64 bit-permuted nibble unpack with deq_scale=64 compensation, DualParam AIV0/AIV1 split-M L1 ring, and zero-copy K-tail narrowing.

fallback_boundary.divisible_tile_count: When total_tiles % aic_num == 0, sk_tiles is 0; skip the Stream-K workspace and global barrier entirely so every tile takes the direct DP L0C->GM path.
fallback_boundary.mx_matmul_hardware_requirement: mx_m16n16k64 with E8M0 block scaling and fp8_e4m3fn inputs requires Ascend950 (c310); on Ascend910B/910_93 use the platform's W4A8/W8A8 QuantBatchMatmul contract.
fallback_boundary.bitwise_single_pass_reference: Splitting K across cores changes floating-point addition associativity; require fp32 reference tolerance validation and byte-identical determinism across repeats rather than bit-identity against a single-core K loop.

retention_rule: Only both_pass cases with verified accuracy against the fp32 reference and byte-identical repeatability enter a paired timing ratio. Correctness prerequisites (fp32 workspace partials, SINGLE_CACHE_LINE invalidation, deq_scale=64 / bias*2^-6 compensation, and 64B/32B K-tail alignment narrowing) remain active in every ablation arm.
